title: Infinite Loop in routing for react-instantsearch

comments.body:
Hi @harshmaur, could you create a simple repository showing this issue? A little create-react-app + simple app showing the infinite loop? That would help :100: solving this bug.

I know it can be tedious to reduce the test/case surface but that's how we are gonna solve this together!
Please reopen this issue here https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch if you still experience it.
